rule: A reminder only, not legal advice. Each row links the official customs page for your home country, read by the build on the checked date. Duty-free limits for alcohol, tobacco and goods change, so verify before you fly.

allowances.summary: Australia has duty-free limits for general goods, alcohol and tobacco. Over a limit, duty and tax apply to everything of that type.
New Zealand has duty-free limits for goods, alcohol and tobacco. Declare anything over them when you arrive.
Great Britain has tax and duty-free allowances for alcohol, tobacco, vaping liquid and other goods. Northern Ireland has its own page.
Coming back to Ireland from outside the EU, there are duty-free allowances for goods, alcohol and tobacco.
Declare what you bought abroad when you return. The duty-free exemption depends on the countries you visited.
Your personal exemption depends on how long you were away, with separate limits for alcohol and tobacco.
Entering the EU from outside it, there are duty-free allowances for alcohol, tobacco and other goods. Some EU countries set higher or lower limits, so check your own.
